bring-animal.title: Bring an animal
bring-animal.definition: Move a named animal into the ritual sequence before another action is performed on it.

externalParallels.description: Rams are supplied at dusk; further animals are brought on later days.

twist-wool.title: Twist coloured wool
twist-wool.definition: Work differently coloured wool into a single strand or cord.

externalParallels.description: White, red and yellow-green wool are combined into a cord for the rams.

make-wreath.title: Make a wool wreath
make-wreath.definition: Shape a prepared wool cord into a circular adornment.

adorn-animal.title: Adorn an animal
adorn-animal.definition: Attach a prepared object or material to a living ritual animal.

externalParallels.description: Wool and metal ornaments are attached to the rams' necks and horns.

move-animal.title: Drive an animal away
move-animal.definition: Move an animal along a prescribed route or out of a ritual area.

externalParallels.description: Rams are driven through the camp and released toward the enemy border.

speak-address.title: Recite an address
speak-address.definition: A prescribed utterance addressed to a deity or spoken as an action is performed.

externalParallels.description: Appeals are recited while the rams are tethered, presented and driven away.

bring-provisions.title: Bring provisions
bring-provisions.definition: Introduce named food, drink or other supplies before their use in the ritual.

externalParallels.description: Bread, beer and other provisions are brought for successive days of the rite.

dedicate-animal.title: Dedicate an animal
dedicate-animal.definition: Assign a particular animal to a named divine recipient.

externalParallels.description: A bull is offered to the Storm-god, a ewe to the Sun-god, and sheep to all gods.

kill-animal.title: Kill an animal
kill-animal.definition: The text explicitly says an animal is killed or slaughtered.

externalParallels.description: Six rams and six billy goats are slaughtered on the second day.

cook-meat.title: Cook meat
cook-meat.definition: The text explicitly says an animal or its flesh is cooked.

externalParallels.description: The slaughtered animals are cooked on the second day.

prepare-offering.title: Prepare an offering
prepare-offering.definition: Arrange named provisions for a named divine recipient.

externalParallels.description: Meat, bread and drink are placed for divine recipients.

tether-animal.title: Tether an animal
tether-animal.definition: Tie an animal at a specified place or time.

wash-hands.title: Wash hands
wash-hands.definition: Wash participants’ hands with a prescribed substance.

pass-between-fires.title: Pass between fires
pass-between-fires.definition: Move through the space between two ritual fires.

select-human.title: Select human substitutes
select-human.definition: Choose people who will stand in for others during a substitution ritual.

remove-garments.title: Remove garments
remove-garments.definition: Take off named garments before transferring them to another person.

dress-substitute.title: Dress a substitute
dress-substitute.definition: Clothe a human substitute in prescribed garments.

draw-wool-from-mouth.title: Draw wool from a mouth
draw-wool-from-mouth.definition: Pull named wool strands from a person's mouth during a ritual transfer.

offer-food-drink.title: Offer food and drink
offer-food-drink.definition: Place or pour named food and drink for a recipient.

collect-clay.title: Collect clay
collect-clay.definition: Take clay from a named source for later ritual use.

build-shelter.title: Build a ritual shelter
build-shelter.definition: Construct a temporary ritual structure at the prescribed place.

make-clay-figures.title: Make clay figures
make-clay-figures.definition: Mold small figures or shapes from collected clay.

put-on-garments.title: Put on garments
put-on-garments.definition: Dress the ritual patient in prescribed clothing.

lift-over-patient.title: Lift over a patient
lift-over-patient.definition: Hold a living animal or object above a ritual patient.

wash-body.title: Wash the body
wash-body.definition: Wash the ritual patient with a named liquid.

remove-wool.title: Remove wool
remove-wool.definition: Take wool thread off the ritual patient.

break-pot.title: Break a pot
break-pot.definition: Smash an empty vessel during a rite.

bathe-over-figure.title: Bathe over a figure
bathe-over-figure.definition: Bathe while a figure is positioned beneath the person.

comb-down.title: Comb downward
comb-down.definition: Draw a comb downward over the patient.

release-into-water.title: Release into water
release-into-water.definition: Send used ritual objects into flowing water.

burn-animals.title: Burn animals
burn-animals.definition: Burn named animals at a prescribed place.

pass-through-gate.title: Pass through a gate
pass-through-gate.definition: Move beneath a temporary ritual gate.

touch-living-exemplar.title: Touch a living exemplar
touch-living-exemplar.definition: Touch a cow or tree used in a spoken analogy.

libate.title: Pour a libation
libate.definition: Pour wine or another liquid for a named recipient.

prepare-clothing.title: Prepare clothing
prepare-clothing.definition: Set out prescribed garments or textile pieces before the patient wears them.

mix-fodder.definition: Mix grain and straw for a ritual provision.
mix-fodder.title: Mix fodder

scatter-provisions.definition: Scatter prepared provisions at a named place.
scatter-provisions.title: Scatter provisions

build-reed-gate.definition: Set up a gate or threshold made of reeds.
build-reed-gate.title: Build reed gate

bind-gate.definition: Bind a ritual gate with coloured wool.
bind-gate.title: Bind gate

give-implements.definition: Place named implements in a participant’s hands.
give-implements.title: Give implements

exchange-implements.definition: Remove one set of implements and give another.
exchange-implements.title: Exchange implements

take-implements.title: Take up ritual implements
take-implements.definition: Gather used ritual implements before closing the rite.

close-door.title: Close a door
close-door.definition: Shut a house or courtyard door in a prescribed rite.

anoint-door.title: Anoint a door
anoint-door.definition: Apply fine oil to a ritual threshold.

take-provisions.title: Take ritual provisions
take-provisions.definition: Gather named animals, food, drink and vessels for a rite.

prepare-provisions.title: Prepare ritual provisions
prepare-provisions.definition: Prepare previously gathered materials for their ritual use.

pass-through-camp.title: Pass through an army camp
pass-through-camp.definition: Move through an army camp during a rite.

observe-bird-omen.title: Observe a bird omen
observe-bird-omen.definition: Read a bird movement as a sign during a rite.

take-funerary-goods.title: Take goods for the dead
take-funerary-goods.definition: Gather named clothing, food, vessels and valuable objects for the dead.

carry-dead.title: Carry out the dead
carry-dead.definition: Bring a dead person outside for a funerary rite.

cremate-dead.title: Cremate the dead
cremate-dead.definition: Burn a dead person in a funerary rite.

thread-amulet-materials.title: Thread amulet materials
thread-amulet-materials.definition: String prescribed materials together on a cord or thread to form an amulet.

wrap-amulet-materials.title: Wrap amulet materials
wrap-amulet-materials.definition: Wrap prescribed ingredients in a textile or skin covering before the amulet is worn.

place-amulet-on-patient.title: Place an amulet on a person
place-amulet-on-patient.definition: Put a prepared amulet on the person for whom the prescription is performed.

lead-donkey.title: Lead a donkey
lead-donkey.definition: Bring a donkey forward as a ritual carrier.

assign-harm-to-carrier.title: Assign harm to a carrier
assign-harm-to-carrier.definition: Speak words assigning an unwanted condition to an animal or object that will be sent away.

send-donkey-away.title: Send a donkey away
send-donkey-away.definition: Drive a donkey carrying harm toward a specified distant place.

break-bread.title: Break bread
break-bread.definition: Break a named bread during a rite.

put-in-basket.title: Put materials in a basket
put-in-basket.definition: Place gathered ritual materials in a basket for removal.

chant-at-gate.title: Chant at a gate
chant-at-gate.definition: Perform a ritual cry at a gate while materials are carried out.

carry-basket-out.title: Carry a basket out
carry-basket-out.definition: Carry a prepared basket out through a gate or boundary.

conjure-on-ground.title: Conjure over ground materials
conjure-on-ground.definition: Speak an incantation over a prepared object on the ground.

release-human-substitute.title: Release a human substitute
release-human-substitute.definition: Send a human ritual carrier away after the incantation.

release-oxen-substitutes.title: Release oxen as substitutes
release-oxen-substitutes.definition: Send oxen away as ritual substitute carriers.

prepare-rite.title: Prepare a rite
prepare-rite.definition: Prepare at a named location when the particular materials are not preserved.

fashion-effigies.title: Fashion representative figures
fashion-effigies.definition: Make figures representing people or agents named in the ritual.

coat-effigies.title: Coat ritual figures
coat-effigies.definition: Cover prepared figures with a named substance.

place-in-pot.title: Place figures in a pot
place-in-pot.definition: Put prepared figures in a named pot or vessel.

burn-effigies.title: Burn ritual figures
burn-effigies.definition: Destroy named representative figures with fire.

constrain-effigies.title: Constrain ritual figures
constrain-effigies.definition: Position or bind representative figures in a prescribed constrained posture.

prepare-censer.title: Set up a censer
prepare-censer.definition: Place a censer with named aromatics before a deity.

crush-effigies.title: Crush ritual figures
crush-effigies.definition: Destroy representative figures by crushing them.

chew-plants.title: Chew named plants
chew-plants.definition: Chew the substances named in the source as part of a ritual treatment.

dismember-animal.title: Divide an animal into parts
dismember-animal.definition: Cut an animal's body into named parts, such as limbs matching the patient's.

take-harm-from-body.title: Take harm from the body
take-harm-from-body.definition: Remove a named harm directly from the patient's body without a stated carrier.

spit-into-carrier.title: Spit into a carrier
spit-into-carrier.definition: The patient spits into an animal or object that will carry the harm.

consult-oracle.title: Consult an oracle
consult-oracle.definition: Put a question about the cause of a misfortune to oracular inquiry.

incubate-dream.title: Sleep for a dream
incubate-dream.definition: Sleep under prescribed conditions, such as purity, to receive a divine message.

crush-ingredients.title: Crush ingredients
crush-ingredients.definition: Pound plants, woods, aromatics or minerals to prepare a remedy.

cook-remedy.title: Cook a remedy
cook-remedy.definition: Boil or decoct prepared ingredients in a liquid to make a medicinal paste.

apply-remedy.title: Apply a remedy
apply-remedy.definition: Put a prepared remedy on the patient's body, e.g. as a bandage or poultice.

draw-magic-circle.title: Draw a magic circle
draw-magic-circle.definition: Mark a bounded circle (zisurrû) around a ritual object or place with flour or gypsum.

gesture-at-figures.title: Point at the figures
gesture-at-figures.definition: Stretch a finger or hand toward representative figures while identifying them in speech.

set-torch-on-figures.title: Set a torch on figures
set-torch-on-figures.definition: Place a torch or fire directly on representative figures.

kindle-torch.title: Kindle a torch
kindle-torch.definition: Light a torch or fire from a named source before using it on ritual objects.

throw-fire-into-vessel.title: Throw fire into a vessel
throw-fire-into-vessel.definition: Cast fire into a crucible or container holding ritual objects.

pound-ingredients.title: Pound ingredients
pound-ingredients.definition: Crush and mix named mineral or plant materials into a paste.

wash-off-door.title: Wash off a door
wash-off-door.definition: Wash applied material off a doorway so that the harm it carried is released.

wrap-in-fleece.title: Wrap in fleece
wrap-in-fleece.definition: Enclose named materials in combed wool or fleece.

bury-at-threshold.title: Bury at a threshold
bury-at-threshold.definition: Bury a prepared deposit in or beside a gate or door socket.

sprinkle-water.title: Sprinkle water
sprinkle-water.definition: Sprinkle pure water on the ground or an object to prepare a ritual setting.

immerse-in-river.title: Immerse in a river
immerse-in-river.definition: Submerge a person or textile in river water as part of removing harm.

touch-object.title: Touch an object
touch-object.definition: Touch a named object or place, often on the way home, to conclude or secure a rite.

gather-remedy-material.title: Gather remedy ingredients
gather-remedy-material.definition: Catch, take or gather a named animal, plant or substance for a medical prescription.

dry-material.title: Salt and dry a material
dry-material.definition: Salt, smear or dry a named ingredient so it can later be crushed.

crush-material.title: Crush remedy ingredients
crush-material.definition: Crush or grind named ingredients for a remedy.

mix-remedy.title: Mix a remedy
mix-remedy.definition: Combine named ingredients with a liquid, flour or other base, including steeping and sifting.

expose-overnight.title: Leave out overnight
expose-overnight.definition: Leave a prepared liquid or remedy outdoors or on the roof overnight, under the stars.

give-remedy.title: Administer a remedy
give-remedy.definition: Give a prepared remedy to the patient to drink or eat, with any stated timing.

anoint-body.title: Anoint the body
anoint-body.definition: Rub or smear a named oil or substance onto the patient.

apply-compress.title: Apply a compress
apply-compress.definition: Heat a compress or pad and apply it to the patient.

carry-remedy.title: Carry a remedy
carry-remedy.definition: Move a prepared remedy from one place to another.
